primary_decoupling.activity_to_decouple: Search for feasible hydration options available right now
primary_decoupling.from_incumbent_bundle: Incumbent bottled-water/beverage companies bundled via retail/convenience/vending distribution (e.g., Nestlé, Coca-Cola, PepsiCo) and the retailers/venues that control on-shelf availability (E11, E14).
primary_decoupling.customer_pain: In-the-moment hydration is constrained by what’s physically nearby, but customers must spend time/effort figuring out which stores/venues have a preferred option available right now, so they default to habit or whatever is visible (E9, E10, E11).
primary_decoupling.new_offering: Launch a lightweight “Liquid Death Now” locator (mobile web + QR + SMS) that shows the nearest places to buy Liquid Death immediately, using venue-verified availability plus user-reported confirmations and recency signals to rank results.
primary_decoupling.why_customer_switches: Customers don’t have to change where they shop or how they pay—they just run a faster search step and get a high-confidence answer on where Liquid Death is available right now, i.e., “peeling away a portion of the customer’s value chain” (books/unlocking-the-customer-value-chain-chapter-1.md) while leaving the rest intact (E6, E11, E15).

do_not_decouple.activity: Purchase the chosen product through an available channel
do_not_decouple.reason: Do not jump into checkout/payments as the wedge: customers already buy through existing retail/convenience/vending channels, and re-owning the transaction would add heavy operational scope while breaking the ‘one-step’ decoupling logic (E11, E15).

do_not_decouple.activity: Consume the water and handle the packaging after use
do_not_decouple.reason: Avoid unbundling disposal/recycling logistics as the next step; it is operationally complex and outside the core disruption lever described here, while incumbents are optimized around production/distribution scale rather than post-use services (E12, E14).

Don’t attempt to ‘own thirst’ as a standalone activity; it’s a universal, low-differentiation trigger and not where incumbents are weak—Liquid Death’s advantage is better applied at the moment of choice/search and brand evaluation (E8, E10, E14).

do_not_decouple.activity: Reflect on experience (including environmental impact) and decide whether to repurchase
do_not_decouple.reason: Don’t lead with retention/repurchase tooling as the primary decoupling wedge until real-time availability search is solved; otherwise it risks building CRM without improving the immediate ‘can I get it right now?’ bottleneck that drives default-to-habit purchases (E9, E11, E13).
